A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the space-time extension of the emission source is determined by the analysis of the longitudinal correlation function and is consistent with the emission from the participant zone of the system.
we have been able to isolate the space-time ambiguity in the analysis of the proton-proton correlation function.

The main takeaway from our work is that
a detailed analysis of the space-time structure of the emission source is only possible with high-resolution correlation functions and the knowledge of the source frame.
the analysis of the correlation function is sensitive to the momentum space structure of the emission source.
the space-time extent and lifetime of the source are intimately connected and cannot be separated without additional information on the collective expansion of the system.
